approach: The beat frequency sets the time from one maximum to the next; a maximum and its adjacent minimum are half of that time apart.

steps.text: Find the beat frequency of the two tuning forks.
Find the time between two successive maxima (the beat period).
A minimum of loudness falls exactly halfway between two successive maxima, so the time from a maximum to the adjacent minimum is half the beat period.
steps.why_this_step: Within one beat period the loudness rises to a maximum, falls through a minimum, and rises to the next maximum, so the minimum sits midway.

common_mistakes.text: Taking the beat period itself, 1/3 s, as the time to the adjacent minimum instead of halving it.
